rubrics.justification: Describes ICM and TE plausibly and generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst, but misstates Gardner expansion by calling 2AA a full blastocyst with zona distension and contrasts it incorrectly with hatching stage terminology.
Integrates age, PCOS/high response, prior biochemical pregnancy, endometrial thickness, BMI/activity, and sperm parameters with embryo prognosis, though some links are somewhat speculative.

Overall structure is logical, but there are notable issues: incorrect staging interpretation, overconfident implantation estimate, and speculative attribution of biochemical pregnancy to thrombophilia/immune factors without supporting data.

SET recommendation and general emphasis on embryo quality/endometrium are guideline-consistent, but PGT-A after a single failed transfer/biochemical and ERA after two failures are more controversial than presented, and exercise restriction advice is not strongly evidence-based.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for SET, luteal support review, and contingency planning, though some suggestions are not strongly evidence-based and could be better prioritized.
